heading: INT. HOTEL BALLROOM - FIRE DRILL - DAY

units.text: INT. HOTEL BALLROOM - FIRE DRILL - DAY
A chandeliered room set for a banquet no one will attend.
Round tables, white cloths, a podium.
An alarm klaxon whoops overhead.
BARCLAY PENHALLOW-DIOP (50s, regional director, bluetooth earpiece) stands on a chair waving a laminated evacuation map.
ROSAMUND TAKAHASHI-FINN (30s, safety warden, high-vis vest over a pantsuit) points a megaphone at the exits.
WINSTON ABERNATHY-KOH (60s, accountant, gripping his briefcase) sits calmly at a table, peeling an orange.
Everybody remain calm and form an orderly line!
units.name: BARCLAY

units.text: Sir, please step down from the chair.
units.name: ROSAMUND

units.text: I'm elevated for visibility!
units.name: BARCLAY

units.text: You're elevated for liability!
units.name: ROSAMUND

units.text: Winston peels a long ribbon of orange.
Barclay jumps down, stumbles, and knocks over a centerpiece.
Rosamund rushes to catch it, collides with Barclay, and both go down in a heap of tablecloth and carnations.
The klaxon whoops.
Winston places an orange segment in his mouth.
Is it a real fire?
units.name: WINSTON

units.text: It's a drill!
units.name: ROSAMUND

units.text: Then why are you on the floor?
units.name: WINSTON

units.text: Realism.
units.name: BARCLAY

units.text: The klaxon cuts off.
Silence settles over the ballroom like a bad dream.
Winston finishes the orange.
Rosamund and Barclay untangle slowly.
Barclay straightens his earpiece.
Good. Excellent. Very instructive.
units.name: BARCLAY

units.text: Sir, you failed.
units.name: ROSAMUND

units.text: I failed instructively.
units.name: BARCLAY
